icons.scope: 96 original/default icon IDs, 23 gallery variants, 30 menu/control sources and paired Image variants retain existing coverage/cache checks. New Pencil/Bucket menu variants are transparent, tintable white vectors tested at multiple densities; colored tool sources retain their original mapping.

gpu.scope: Fresh light/dark dropdown scenes; eight archived shape-paint captures show both choices selected in each menu. Client scenes, not native title/menu bars.

generator: All 30 menu/control sources and manifest regenerate byte for byte with scripts/generate_classic_menu_icons.py. New artwork is original, not extracted native assets.
scope: Classic v11 Shape outline/Shape fill triggers use explicit 22-point monochrome pen-over-box/bucket variants. Existing working choices use bounded 220-point popup bodies, contiguous 40-point rows and 16-point labels. Selected outlines and hover/open state remain. Default colored tool artwork, Studio and historical options paths retain their existing behavior.
regressions: Light 1x/dark 2x wide layouts and dark 2x at 360x360 verify actual glyph size/tint, row bounds/contiguity, aligned text, selected accessibility state, Escape dismissal and Both/Filled/Outline transitions without document/history publication. The narrow case pans the outer ribbon via a direct child before clicking Rectangle, then reveals each dropdown. Existing test still draws the filled shape and checks a real interior pixel; all ordinary tests pass.
limits: This qualifies existing solid/no-outline/no-fill presentation and interaction. It does not add textured styles or extra shape implementations, prove exact native popup parity, complete physical input/text-device checks or finish the roadmap. Native presentation was separately qualified by the preceding record.
